units.source_text: 男人腋下吊着绳索，像吊货物似的又给吊回洞穴里去了。

en.t: With the rope slung under his arms, the man was hoisted back down into the hole like a piece of cargo.

units.source_text: 谁也没说话，简直就像在举行葬礼。

en.t: No one said a word; it was almost as if they were holding a funeral.
The hole was deep and dark.

units.source_text: 月亮撒下绢绸似的淡淡光芒，笼罩着整个沙丘，

en.t: The moon cast a faint, silk-like light over the whole sand dune,

units.source_text: 连风纹和足迹都像玻璃皱褶似的浮现出来，

en.t: so that even the wind ripples and footprints stood out like wrinkles in glass,

units.source_text: 然而只有这里，像是被拒绝加入风景似的，只有伸手不见五指的黑暗。

en.t: yet this place alone, as though refused entry into the landscape, was nothing but darkness so thick he could not see his hand before his face.
But he did not care very much.

units.source_text: 他茫然地抬头看看月亮，头晕目眩，

en.t: He looked up blankly at the moon, dizzy and light-headed,

units.source_text: 只想呕吐，疲倦到了极点。

en.t: wanting only to vomit, utterly exhausted.
